headline: Trevor Noah is hosting Google’s Pixel 11 launch event
summary: Trevor Noah will host Google's Pixel 11 hardware event on August 12th. Other celebrities and influencers are expected to feature. The event will unveil new Made by Google devices.

headline: Jony Ive's first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
summary: Jony Ive and OpenAI are developing a battery-powered, "doughnut-shaped" smart speaker. The device is rumored to be roughly the size of a hockey puck and lack a display. Expected in 2027, it could cost over $300.

headline: The AirPods Pro are $60 off, their best price since late June
summary: AirPods Pro are currently on sale for $189.99, a $60 discount. This marks their lowest price since late June. The deal is available at Best Buy, Amazon, and Walmart.

headline: The Zelda movie’s Ganondorf casting hints at more movies
summary: Uli Latukefu is cast as Ganondorf in the upcoming Legend of Zelda movie. Latukefu reportedly signed a multi-picture deal. This suggests Nintendo and Sony may be planning multiple Zelda films.

headline: Will Wight's Cradle Series Is a Must-Read for Anime Fans Who Just Discovered Their Love of LitRPG
summary: Will Wight's Cradle Series is recommended for anime fans. It's highlighted as a must-read for those new to LitRPG. The series combines fantasy and role-playing game elements.

headline: Layoffs Hit Staff at Crossfire Developer That’s No Moon
summary: Crossfire developer That's No Moon has announced staff layoffs. The gaming industry continues to see widespread job cuts. The exact number of affected employees is currently undisclosed.

headline: The First Fourth Wing Graphic Novel Is Up for Preorder on Amazon, Out April 2027
summary: The first Fourth Wing graphic novel is now available for preorder. The much-anticipated release is slated for April 2027. Fans can secure their copy through Amazon.

headline: American Squid Game Spinoff Series Reportedly Canceled at Netflix
summary: Netflix has reportedly canceled the American Squid Game spinoff series. David Fincher was attached to the project. Sources close to production confirmed the shelving.

headline: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
summary: Meta was fined $567 million in a landmark child safety ruling. A New Mexico judge cited harm to children on Meta platforms. This is the largest fine against a social media giant for child safety.

headline: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
summary: Donald Trump denied claims of a US weapons shortage. He stated "leakers" of this information are being "hunted down". Public data suggests depletion of difficult-to-manufacture weapons.

headline: Thousands of rail passengers hit by power failure disruption
summary: A power failure in Manchester caused widespread rail disruption. Thousands of passengers faced delays and cancellations. Services are expected to be affected throughout the evening.

headline: Arrests in Norfolk town as disorder continues for third night
summary: Arrests have been made in a Norfolk town following three nights of disorder. The unrest is linked to anti-immigration protests. Local authorities are addressing ongoing disturbances.
